text:
GENERATE BURST L10-sky-single — Run C-9 P5, the SUNSET SKY painted as ONE image (Matt R-C9-21: sunset, and NOTHING may repeat). task_id "L10-sky-single".

Paint ONE landscape 1536x1024 image: the sunset sky, the farthest backdrop of a game scene, in the palette and painted hand of IMAGE 1 (keep its colours, cloud style and pen-and-wash handling). Exactly ONE sun: a small pale-gold disc sitting LOW near the LEFT edge, half-veiled by cloud, with the brightest gold glow around it. A warm band of gold, apricot and rose along the LOWER third, rising through violet to a dusky blue-violet at the TOP. Long, thin, stylised clouds lit rose and gold from below — every cloud a DIFFERENT shape and size, NO regular rows or stripes of cloud. Exactly TWO columns of dark smoke rising from below the RIGHT half of the bottom edge (from a burning valley out of frame): one large and billowing, one thinner and farther away, different shapes, leaning slightly with the wind, NOT parallel diagonal bands. NO land, NO stars, NOT a night sky, no text, no border.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if there is more than one sun, the smoke columns repeat or run as parallel stripes, the clouds form repeated rows, or it reads as a night sky — name the reason. Copy the output to out/L10-sky-single.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L10-sky-single"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — palette and painted hand of the sky (NOT its layout; its sun/plume layout is what is being fixed)
